# HERCOSSNUX PQC Layer 4 self-test vector, ML-DSA-65.
# One line, four fields: xi mu pk sk sig kappa
#
# The self-test runs KeyGen, then Sign, then Verify on ONE datapath,
# and checks two different things:
#   - every intermediate output against the ACVP expected bytes, which
#     anchors the core to the standard and no shared defect can satisfy
#   - that Verify accepts the signature the other two produced, which
#     is a property the vector comparison does not cover
#
# Only the second would pass on a core with a wrong NTT constant used
# consistently by all three operations: it would interoperate with
# itself perfectly and not be ML-DSA. That is the RTL-vs-RTL common
# mode the Phase 0 test closed in the SpaceWire and 1553 cores.
